targets.old_statement: The Move It Law moves drivable vehicles from a minor injury-free crash on a divided highway; under Accident Alert Status, drivers in a qualifying crash exchange information and file a report within 24 hours.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The Move It Law moves drivable vehicles from a minor injury-free crash on a divided highway; under Accident Alert Status, drivers in a qualifying crash exchange information and file a report within twenty-four hours.
targets.statement: When vehicles are drivable and neither injuries nor drugs or alcohol are involved, the Move It Law requires clearing a minor divided-highway crash off the road, whereas Accident Alert Status requires exchanging details and reporting within twenty-four hours.

targets.old_statement: The Move Over Law has two branches: change lanes when safe, or if you cannot, slow to at least 20 mph below the posted limit.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The Move Over Law has two branches: change lanes when safe, or if you cannot, slow to at least twenty miles per hour below the posted limit.
targets.statement: For any stationary highway vehicle flashing its hazards, the Move Over Law requires moving over one lane when safe, or slowing to at least twenty miles per hour below the posted speed limit if unsafe or on a road with one lane each way.
